Title:
Molecular Informatics Toolkit for Compound-Protein Interaction
in Drug Discovery
Authors@R:

A molecular informatics toolkit with an integration of
bioinformatics and chemoinformatics tools for drug discovery.

Software, DataImport, DataRepresentation, FeatureExtraction,
Cheminformatics, BiomedicalInformatics, Proteomics, GO,
SystemsBiology
